name: Genasys Protect
description: Commercial wildfire behavior and mass evacuation simulation platform used by fire agencies and emergency managers. Models real-time fire spread dynamics and evacuation traffic under rapidly changing weather conditions. Integrates with Genasys emergency alert systems for end-to-end emergency management workflow.
domain: wildfire management, mass evacuation, emergency alert
general_score_metric: composite_score (operational scenario outcome accuracy / evacuation success rate)
reputation: established commercial platform used by California CAL FIRE and multiple state/county emergency management agencies
notes: Commercial SaaS platform. Formerly known as ZONEHAVEN (acquired by Genasys). Strong adoption in California and western US fire agencies. Integrates with public alert and warning systems.
